description: Qualcomm Incorporated, incorporated in California in 1985 and reincorporated in Delaware in 1991, is a global technology leader helping to bring intelligent computing everywhere through the development and commercialization of foundational technologies, including on-device artificial intelligence, high-performance and low-power computing and advanced wireless connectivity. Its platforms help power intelligent devices that people and businesses rely on every day across industries, and it operates and reports using a 52-53 week fiscal year ending on the last Sunday in September, with fiscal years for 2025, 2024 and 2023 including 52 weeks, 53 weeks and 52 weeks, respectively.
